name: daily-agent-followups
description: Desktop app that turns the daily PDF report into copy-pasteable follow-up messages per sales agent.

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && npm run build:electron && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 node scripts/run-electron.mjs"
scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && npm run build:electron
